title: The Song of Moses and Marah

questions.question: What did Moses and the Israelites do after crossing the Red Sea?
options: Sang a song to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Sang a song to the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:1 (ESV): "Then Moses and the people of Israel sang this song to the Lord."

questions.question: Who led the women in dancing with tambourines?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:20 (ESV): "Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand."

questions.question: What was wrong with the water at Marah?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:23 (ESV): "They could not drink the water of Marah because it was bitter."

questions.question: How did God make the water at Marah drinkable?
options: He showed Moses a log to throw into the water
questions.correctAnswer: He showed Moses a log to throw into the water
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:25 (ESV): "The Lord showed him a log, and he threw it into the water, and the water became sweet."

questions.question: Where did the Israelites camp after Marah?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:27 (ESV): "Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees."

questions.question: What famous declaration begins the Song of Moses?
options: I will sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously
questions.correctAnswer: I will sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:1 (ESV): "I will sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea."

questions.question: How is the Lord described as a warrior in the song?
options: The Lord is a man of war
The Lord is a mighty judge
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord is a man of war
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:3 (ESV): "The Lord is a man of war; the Lord is his name."

questions.question: What promise did God make at Marah about disease?
options: He would put none of the diseases of Egypt on them if they obeyed
He would send plagues on their enemies
questions.correctAnswer: He would put none of the diseases of Egypt on them if they obeyed
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:26 (ESV): "I will put none of the diseases on you that I put on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord, your healer."

questions.question: What name did God reveal about Himself at Marah?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:26 (ESV): "For I am the Lord, your healer."

questions.question: What did the people do when they found bitter water at Marah?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:24 (ESV): "And the people grumbled against Moses, saying, 'What shall we drink?'"

questions.question: How many springs of water and palm trees were at Elim?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:27 (ESV): "There were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there by the water."

questions.question: According to the song, what happened to the Egyptians in the depths?
options: They sank like a stone and like lead in mighty waters
questions.correctAnswer: They sank like a stone and like lead in mighty waters
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:5,10 (ESV): "They went down into the depths like a stone... they sank like lead in the mighty waters."

questions.question: Which nations are mentioned as trembling when they heard about the sea crossing?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:14-15 (ESV): "The peoples have heard; they tremble; pangs have seized the inhabitants of Philistia... the chiefs of Edom... the leaders of Moab... all the inhabitants of Canaan."

questions.question: What relationship is Miriam said to have in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:20 (ESV): "Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine."

questions.question: What does the song declare about God's reign?
options: He will reign until the exodus is over
The Lord will reign forever and ever
He will reign for a thousand years
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord will reign forever and ever
questions.explanation: Exodus 15:18 (ESV): "The Lord will reign forever and ever."

key_verse_text: The Lord is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation; this is my God, and I will praise him, my father's God, and I will exalt him.
